Respondent  ---------
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE RONGON MUKHOPADHYAY HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE PRADEEP KUMAR SRIVASTAVA ----------
For the Appellant : Mr. Gautam Kumar, Advocate.
For the Respondent : Mrs. Shweta Singh, A.P.P.

Heard Mr. Gautam Kumar, learned counsel for the appellant and learned A.P.P.
2.
This application has been preferred by the appellant for grant of bail to him during pendency of this appeal.

3. The appellant has been convicted for the offence under Section 376(2)
(n) of I.P.C and under Section 6 of the POCSO Act and has been sentenced to undergo imprisonment for 14 years along with fine of Rs.20,000/- for the offence under Section 376 (2) of the I.P.C.
4.
It has been alleged that while the informant was returning to her village the appellant had accosted her and forced her to develop friendship with him.

Subsequent thereto, it has been alleged that on the false pretext of marriage, the informant was taken by the appellant to a place where she was kept for one week and during that period, the victim was sexually exploited repeatedly by the appellant.

sentences.text: 5. Submission has been advanced by the learned counsel for the appellant that he is in custody since 09.05.2018 and has completed more than half of the sentence imposed upon him.
6. Learned Additional Public Prosecutor has submitted based upon the custody report that the appellant is in custody for more than eight years.
7. Regard being had to the period of custody undergone by the appellant, we are inclined to admit the appellant on bail.

Accordingly, during the pendency of this appeal, the appellant is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount to the satisfaction of Learned Additional Sessions Judge-I, West Singhbhum, at Chaibasa in Special POCSO Case No. 18/2018 in arising out of Mufassil P.S. Case No. 51 of 2018 in CNR No.
JHCB01-000827-2018).
8. 8.
